exposure: history of hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism in pregnancy
history of drug use in neonatal period
cohort: The study included 404 children aged 7-12 years (196 with ADHD and 208 without ADHD) from an unspecified population.
finding: Long-term breastfeeding (more than 12 months) was significantly associated with a protective effect against ADHD, with shorter mean breastfeeding duration observed in children with ADHD.
followup_time: 7-12 years after birth (age of children at study)
